purpose: Original replacement graphics for the MiniPixels examples
processing: Grid crops, aspect-preserving scaling and runtime sheet assembly; nearest-neighbor except area-sampled foreground foliage. Trees are prepared at native 64px, bushes at 32px. Transparent alpha preserved. Generated source images retained below.

player_run_balanced.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production eight-frame RUN animation sprite sheet, genuine transparent background. Reference image is the identity/style reference only: same small right-facing turquoise hooded courier with blond face, leaf pin, cream tunic, satchel and brown boots. Make a CONSISTENT compact eight-frame jog cycle, 4 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, row-major order. All poses have the exact same head/body proportions and modest same-length legs, no lunges, no giant stride or elongated boot. Stable head and pelvis registration, camera strictly side view facing RIGHT, equal timing for both half strides. Sequence: contact, down/recoil, passing/push, up/flight; opposite-leg contact, down/recoil, passing/push, up/flight. Near and far legs exchange roles, near leg bright brown, far leg darker. Near foot moves from ahead of hips through underneath to behind hips and then swings forward again, arms counter-swing. Second half cycle mirrors only the LEG ROLES, never the whole character. Every face points right. Torso very stable, at most a tiny equal bounce in each half cycle, no limping. Short relaxed stride suitable for 32px character. Each sprite centered in its cell, ample transparent margins, planted feet share baseline; raised flight feet do not reach ground. Crisp 16-bit pixel clusters same palette as reference, no text, numbers, floor, cast shadows, grid lines or scenery.

Keep legs SHORT with the same length as other frames; no stretched or giant legs. In SECOND ROW SECOND CELL (frame6) near knee folds behind body to LEFT while dark far foot supports under hips. In SECOND ROW THIRD CELL (frame7) near knee moves forward RIGHT and far foot pushes behind LEFT. All faces continue RIGHT. Do NOT change anything above the waist. All eight poses retain identical head/body dimensions and similar overall heights, genuine transparent background, no text or shadows. Clear alternating-leg jogging action, not eight duplicate generic running poses.

near.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: THREE separate parallax forest foreground STRIPS in a production pixel-art atlas, true transparent background. Wide canvas. player_run.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: usable eight-frame RUN CYCLE sprite sheet for a pixel-art platformer, transparent background. Input image is ONLY the identity/style reference: keep exactly this turquoise hooded forest courier, blond hair, leaf pin, cream tunic, dark trousers, brown boots and satchel, side view facing RIGHT. Replace the animation poses: the old sheet is defective because the same leg points forward in every running frame. This new sheet must show a real COMPLETE alternating-leg run cycle. EXACTLY 8 equal square cells arranged 4 columns x 2 rows, read left-to-right then next row, no idle/jump poses. Same scale, centered pelvis and consistent head proportions across frames. Near leg is brighter and far leg is darker so they can be tracked. Frame 1 near foot forward touching ground, far leg extended backward; 2 near foot supports under body, far knee swings forward; 3 near leg pushes backward, far knee lifted in front; 4 airborne transition, near heel raised behind, far foot reaching forward; 5 FAR foot forward touching ground, NEAR leg extended BACKWARD (opposite of frame 1); 6 FAR foot supports under body, NEAR knee swings forward; 7 FAR leg pushes backward, NEAR knee lifted in front; 8 airborne transition into frame 1. Counter-swing the arms. Clear large readable leg silhouettes at 32x32 final size. Stable torso, only slight vertical bounce. Frame 5 is NOT a copy of frame 1: near/far legs must trade places. No whole-character horizontal flips: every face points right. Full bodies entirely inside each cell with at least 15% margins; shared baseline near 85% cell height for contact frames, flight feet slightly above it. Match existing pixel-art palette and character identity, crisp pixel clusters. Transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no grid lines, no numbering, no extra characters.

Near thigh descends diagonally LEFT, near shin and boot extend LEFT, not right. In bottom-row frame2 (cell6), bright near knee and boot lift behind the hips on LEFT while dark far boot supports under the hips. In bottom-row frame3(cell7), bright near knee begins swinging forward from the LEFT and dark far leg pushes rearward. Bottom-row frame4(cell8) transitions into top-left pose. The bright near leg must visibly travel from RIGHT in top row, underneath the hips, to LEFT in bottom row, underneath hips, back to RIGHT on loop. Counter-swing arms accordingly. Do NOT flip face or entire character: face stays looking RIGHT in every frame. Two distinguishable legs, the rear/far leg dark blue and brown, front/near leg highlighted gold brown boot. No duplicated stance legs. Eight frames total, no added text or cell borders. Genuine transparent alpha. This is correcting leg motion in an actual running animation, not eight character illustrations.
